pr.title: feat(QPBT/Extraction): preserve nonencoding mass bound
pr.body:
### Motivation
- Preserve the existing issue #517 proof from PR #543 against current main
  without reviving superseded Lean modules or old proof holes. The correction
  to the chapter-14 decoding step (lines 1483-1492) needs a separate bound on
  non-encoding polynomial marginal outcomes, documented in
  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex` and blueprint
  `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`.

### Description
- Reuse the saved proof of `nonencodingMarginalMass_le` at its identical
  supplied-`GlobalPairWitness` statement; add only its existing support import.
- Mark the existing chapter-16 node as a proved *auxiliary* supplied-witness
  estimate. The main source-facing construction already obtains its witness
  and uses separate proved estimates; it does not call this theorem.
- Update the two stale decoding gap-status statements and restore the dated
  issue-517 audit with original proof provenance and failed-PR-CI history.

### Testing
- `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean`
- `lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.Consistency`
- Fresh `#print axioms` for the target, reference comparison, constructor,
  source-facing composition and unrelated open absorption theorem: standard
  axioms only for the first four; `sorryAx` only for unrelated absorption.
- `texra-blueprint bbl`, `leanblueprint web`, canonical blueprint sync
  `--update-lean-decls` and `--ci`, paper-gap check, changed-note style check,
  `git diff --check`, ordinary pre-commit hooks.
- No full CI, publication, independent review or merge was run here.

---
Addresses #517
